title: Concept: Dependency pinned to a dist-tag
description: package.json declares a specifier that names a moving dist-tag, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a specifier that names a moving dist-tag.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a specifier that names a moving dist-tag.
